## Appearance

_Not yet known._

## Personality

Gertie Pye is known for her dishonest behavior as a cheat, as well as her habitual tardiness, which some attribute to a desire to make a dramatic entrance. Additionally, she causes discomfort to others by constantly squeaking her pencil.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026), [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P18](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0018), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P35](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0035)_

## History

During an [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) meeting, Gertie Pye alerted the gathered members to Judson Parker's plan to rent his fence for advertisements.

_Sources: [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P4](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0004), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P15](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0015), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P35](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0035), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P50](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0050)_

## Relationships

### [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/gertie-pye--jane-andrews.md)

Gertie Pye and [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) serve together as members of the subscription committee for the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village Improvement Society's hall painting project. They collaborate on community affairs, such as attending society meetings and joining forces with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to address issues affecting the village's appearance, including attempting to persuade [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) not to rent his fence for advertisements.

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P10](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0010), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P4](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0004), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P15](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0015), +2 more_

- Comrade of — members of the subscription committee for the hall (since v2)  <sub>[v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P10](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0010)</sub>
